_note: A made-up client for tests, modelled on the shape of a real job that got no designs (2026-11-12): a small software site whose capture yields a hero, a short run of steps without pictures, a statement, two figures and three photographs; no features, no close, no product screens, no plans, no links. The name, the words and the numbers are invented; no real business is described.

hero.title: Turn a Plain Document into a Designed One
hero.text: Upload a report, a letter or a handout and get it back laid out like a printed page.

figures.l: From upload to a finished layout, on a ten-page report

statement.title: Your words stay exactly as you wrote them
statement.text: Pagewright changes the type, the spacing and the page around your text, never the text itself, so a reviewed document stays the reviewed document.

items.title: Upload the document
items.text: Drop in a PDF, a Word file or plain text; nothing needs to be prepared first.

items.title: Pick a page style
items.text: Choose a look for headings, margins and tables, and see the first page before you commit.

items.title: Download the result
items.text: Get a print-ready PDF back, with the contents and page numbers set for you.
